rule_text.name: 702.202a
rule_text.rule: Mirage represents two static abilities, one that functions while the card with mirage is on the stack, and one which may create a delayed triggered ability. “Mirage (cost)” means “You may cast this card as though it had flash by paying (cost) rather than its mana cost,” and “If this spell's mirage cost was paid, sacrifice the permanent this spell becomes at the beginning of the next cleanup step.”

rule_text.name: 702.202b
rule_text.rule: Permanents with mirage will leave the battlefield after damage is removed from permanents and 'until end of turn' and 'this turn' effects end.

rule_text.name: 702.202c
rule_text.rule: If the triggered ability of mirage is countered, it will not trigger again.

rule_text.name: 702.202a
rule_text.rule: Mirage represents two static abilities, one that functions while the card with mirage is on the stack, and one which may create a delayed triggered ability. “Mirage (cost)” means “You may cast this card as though it had flash by paying (cost) rather than its mana cost,” and “If this spell's mirage cost was paid, sacrifice the permanent this spell becomes at the beginning of the next cleanup step.”

rule_text.name: 702.202b
rule_text.rule: Permanents with mirage will leave the battlefield after damage is removed from permanents and 'until end of turn' and 'this turn' effects end.

rule_text.name: 702.202c
rule_text.rule: If the triggered ability of mirage is countered, it will not trigger again.
